prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: 1024x1024 marketplace plugin icon for an agent runtime and automation toolkit named Agent Harness
Primary request: Create a distinctive abstract icon that communicates one orchestrating harness coordinating several execution paths. Use a bold central luminous core connected to three compact nodes by a single elegant loop or bridle-like orbit. The mark should feel engineered, trustworthy, and energetic, with superb clarity at 32 px and 64 px.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed deep midnight-indigo square background, subtle dimensional depth but no scenery
Style/medium: premium modern 3D-vector hybrid, crisp geometric silhouette, restrained glass-and-metal highlights, not photorealistic
Composition/framing: one large centered symbol occupying about 68 percent of the canvas, generous safe margin, balanced and nearly symmetrical
Lighting/mood: controlled cyan and violet glow with one small warm amber accent, high contrast, polished developer-tool aesthetic
Color palette: midnight navy, electric cyan, ultraviolet, tiny amber accent
Constraints: no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no terminal prompt glyph, no robot, no human, no brand imitation, no watermark; avoid thin lines and tiny details; the silhouette must remain recognizable when downscaled; square corners, no transparency, no border frame

provenance.receipt_note: The built-in generator did not expose a model or version receipt.
provenance.postprocessing: Normalized to a 1024x1024 opaque RGB PNG.

checks: save the selected image into the plugin workspace as assets/icon.png
normalize the selected asset to a 1024x1024 opaque RGB PNG
inspect the image at 1024, 64, and 32 px
reject visible text, letters, tiny details, screenshots, photos, watermarks, brand imitation, or low contrast
wire interface.composerIcon, interface.logo, and interface.brandColor after the file exists
record the SHA-256 of the final post-processed asset, not the generator source
